shapeDecision.reason: Current Figma, Material Web latest generated tokens, and pinned Compose generated size tokens agree on the Round/Square container-shape matrix and pressed target shapes.

precisionPointerDecision.canonicalWebBehavior: no automatic Button density/size change based on pointer hardware
precisionPointerDecision.composeTrigger: feature flag enabled AND physical alphabetic keyboard present AND physical mouse present; drawing-tablet stylus+mouse devices are excluded from mouse classification
precisionPointerDecision.figma: No precision-pointer/density variant property exists in the five reviewed Button component sets.
precisionPointerDecision.materialWeb: No equivalent Button size/device-policy API is exposed by the reviewed public runtime.
precisionPointerDecision.reason: CSS pointer/hover media queries or the current PointerEvent.pointerType are not semantically equivalent to Compose system device inventory plus feature flag. Web Button keeps explicit size selection and stable touch-target semantics until a normative/current web source defines an equivalent policy.
